import uiautomation as auto
title='public-b · Folder · [BUGBOUNTY] foto6 test — Mozilla Firefox'
root=auto.GetRootControl()
wins=[c for c in root.GetChildren() if (getattr(c,'Name','') or '')==title]
print('windows',len(wins))
if not wins: raise SystemExit(3)
q=[(wins[0],0)]
n=0
while q and n<300:
    c,d=q.pop(0)
    try:
        name=getattr(c,'Name','') or ''
        aid=getattr(c,'AutomationId','') or ''
        typ=getattr(c,'ControlTypeName','') or ''
        cls=getattr(c,'ClassName','') or ''
        if name or aid or typ:
            print(d,typ,repr(name[:180]),repr(aid[:100]),repr(cls[:100]))
        n+=1
        if d<4:
            for ch in c.GetChildren():
                q.append((ch,d+1))
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERR',d,type(e).__name__)
print('nodes',n)
'@; py -c $code
